# Workshop "Agent Orchestration with Claude"

[Português](README.md) · **English**

Workshop kit: the one-command setup, the skills and agents, the cost hooks, the statusline, the orchestrator and the hands-on projects (the Security Arena and the practice project). Kit version: **v1.0.0-dev.3**.

## Install (participants)

You need an account on the [Anthropic Console](https://platform.claude.com) with credits. You don't need admin rights.

**macOS** (Terminal):

```bash
curl -fsSL https://gitea.guilhermepinto.pt/guilherme/workshop-claude/releases/download/v1.0.0-dev.3/setup-mac.sh | bash
```

**Windows** (PowerShell):

```powershell
irm https://gitea.guilhermepinto.pt/guilherme/workshop-claude/releases/download/v1.0.0-dev.3/bootstrap-windows.ps1 | iex
```

The setup takes 10 to 20 minutes. If it stops halfway, run the same command again: finished steps are skipped. Full guide, with the pre-work: [docs/en/INSTALL.md](docs/en/INSTALL.md).

## Check (on the workshop day)

| | macOS | Windows |
|---|---|---|
| Check | `bash ~/.workshop-claude/setup-mac.sh --check` | `powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "$HOME\.workshop-claude\setup-windows.ps1" -Check` |
| Diagnosis with Claude | `bash ~/.workshop-claude/setup-mac.sh --doctor` | `powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "$HOME\.workshop-claude\setup-windows.ps1" -Doctor` |
| Uninstall | `bash ~/.workshop-claude/setup-mac.sh --uninstall` | `powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "$HOME\.workshop-claude\setup-windows.ps1" -Uninstall` |

With no previous install, the check also runs directly: `curl -fsSL https://gitea.guilhermepinto.pt/guilherme/workshop-claude/releases/download/v1.0.0-dev.3/setup-mac.sh | bash -s -- --check` (macOS) or `$env:WORKSHOP_SETUP_ARGS='-Check'; irm https://gitea.guilhermepinto.pt/guilherme/workshop-claude/releases/download/v1.0.0-dev.3/bootstrap-windows.ps1 | iex` (Windows).

Something failed? Every error has a code. See [docs/en/TROUBLESHOOTING.md](docs/en/TROUBLESHOOTING.md).

## What the setup does

| Step | What | Where |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | Detects the system, the proxy, TLS interception, OneDrive and the network | `~/.workshop-claude/ca.pem` (only with a company certificate) |
| 1 | git (Mac: Command Line Tools; Windows: Git for Windows for the current user only) | system / `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Git` |
| 2 | Claude Code 2.1.292 (official installer) | `~/.local/bin` |
| 3 | Console login (`claude auth login --console`) | Keychain / `~/.claude` |
| 4 | Node.js (the existing one if ≥ 22; otherwise 24.22.0, verified with SHA-256) | `~/.workshop-claude/node` |
| 5 | uv 0.13.1 | `~/.local/bin` |
| 6 | GitHub CLI 2.102.0 and `gh auth login` | `~/.workshop-claude/bin` |
| 7 | Jira MCP (Atlassian), user scope | `~/.claude.json` |
| 8 | Skills, `ws-*` agents, cost hooks and statusline, with a safe merge of `settings.json` | `~/.claude/`, `~/.workshop-claude/kit` |
| 9 | Workshop projects | `~/workshop-claude/` |
| 10 | Memória app v0.4.0 (optional, does not block) | `uv tool`, `~/.memoria` |
| 11 | Claude Desktop (optional, `--no-desktop / -NoDesktop` skips it) | `~/Applications` |
| 12 | Final test with Haiku and the cost from `pricing.json` | — |

Everything installed is recorded in `~/.workshop-claude/manifest.json`. `settings.json` is backed up in `~/.workshop-claude/backup/`. The log (without secrets) is in `~/.workshop-claude/setup.log`.

**Languages.** The setup speaks English only, and so do its options (the old Portuguese ones still work). It detects the machine language and, if you don't have Claude Code's `language` setting yet, writes it (Portuguese, English, Hindi or Hebrew). The skills and agents are written in English and answer in your language. The Arena, the orchestrator and the statusline are in Portuguese on a Portuguese machine and in English on all others; `WORKSHOP_LANG=pt` or `WORKSHOP_LANG=en` forces one of them.

## Layout

| Folder | Contents |
|---|---|
| `setup/` | `setup-mac.sh`, `setup-windows.ps1`, `bootstrap-windows.ps1` and the message catalogs: `messages.en.json` (what the setup shows) and `messages.pt.json` (the Portuguese TROUBLESHOOTING) |
| `installer/` | Node installer, the same on both systems (`install-user.mjs`, `assemble-demo.mjs`, `assemble-sandbox.mjs`) |
| `hooks/`, `statusline/`, `orquestrador/` | Cost measurement and swarm orchestration |
| `skills-demo/`, `skills-prod/`, `skills-shared/`, `agents/` | Skills and agents (in English; they answer in the user's language) |
| `demo-project/`, `exemplo-projeto-real/` | Hands-on projects |
| `tools/` | `render.mjs`, `build-release.sh`, `publish-release.sh`, `switch-repos.*`, `check-repo.mjs` and the tests |
| `docs/` | Install, troubleshooting, publishing; English versions in `docs/en/` |
